match.reason: No point in the bank covers the cash flow statement; the closest ones, on profit, financing and why small businesses fail, only mention cash flow problems in passing and don't teach the statement's three activity sections.

draft.title: The cash flow statement
card: A cash flow statement shows the cash that came into a business and went out of it over a period, such as a year. It records actual cash movements, not sales made on credit that have not yet been paid.
cash from the day-to-day running of the business, such as cash received from customers and cash paid to suppliers and employees.
cash spent on or received from buying and selling long-term assets, such as equipment or property.
cash from owners and lenders, such as money raised by a loan or owner contributions, and cash paid back as loan repayments or drawings.
draft.remember: The cash flow statement tracks real cash in and out, sorted into operating, investing and financing.

a.q: Which cash flow is an investing activity?
opts: Buying a delivery van with cash
Repaying part of a bank loan
a.why: A delivery van is a long-term asset, so buying it is an investing activity. Paying wages is tempting, but wages are part of the day-to-day running of the business, so they are operating.

b.q: Priya's bakery in Orange borrows $20,000 from a bank. It also sells $5,000 of bread on credit, and the customers have not yet paid. What does the cash flow statement show for the period?
opts: Loan as financing cash in, and no cash from credit sales
Loan as financing cash in, and $5,000 as operating cash in
Loan as investing cash in, and no cash from credit sales
Loan as operating cash in, and $5,000 as operating cash in
b.why: A loan from a lender is a financing activity, and the cash arrived. The credit sales are not cash until customers pay, so they are not recorded yet. Recording the $5,000 as operating cash is tempting, but the statement records only actual cash movements.
b.clue: Has the cash from the credit sales arrived yet?

a.best: Buying a delivery van with cash

b.best: Loan as financing cash in, and no cash from credit sales
